text:
All 10 tests pass. I fixed three surgical bugs in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — was `list(set(items))` which loses insertion order. Replaced with a `seen` set + list that preserves first-occurrence order.

2. **`partition`** — was returning `no, yes` (swapped). Changed to `return yes, no` so matches come first.

3. **`windows`** — the range `range(0, len(items) - k)` dropped the final window. Fixed to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)`.

The 7 previously-passing tests still pass.
